header.running_head: Giving Due Regard to all Those Who have Some Relationship with Rasulullaah ﷺ, Whether they are His Companions, His Family, His Tribe or his Ummah

blocks.text: Hadhrat Ummu Salamah (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ's daughter Hadhrat Faatima (RA) once came to Rasulullaah ﷺ carrying (her sons) Hadhrat Hasan (RA) and Hadhrat Husayn (RA) on her hips. In her hand she was carrying a pot belonging to Hadhrat Hasan (RA) in which there was some hot food. When she put the pot down before Rasulullaah ﷺ, he asked, "Where is Abul Hasan (Hadhrat Ali (RA))?" When Hadhrat Faatima (RA) informed him that Hadhrat Ali (RA) was at home, Rasulullaah ﷺ called him. Rasulullaah ﷺ then sat down to eat with Hadhrat Ali (RA), Hadhrat Faatima (RA), Hadhrat Hasan (RA) and Hadhrat Husayn (RA). Hadhrat Ummu Salamah (RA) continues, "However, Rasulullaah ﷺ did not call me whereas whenever he ate food, he would always call for me if I was there. After eating, Rasulullaah ﷺ covered them all in his shawl and said, "O Allaah! You be the enemy of those who are their enemies and You be the friend of those who are their friends."[^1]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once said, "O progeny of Abdul Muttalib! I have asked Allaah for three things for you. That He keeps steadfast those of you who are established (on Deen), that He educates those of you who are ignorant and that He guides those of you who are misguided. I have also asked Allah to make you extremely generous and merciful. Even though a person may be engaged in Ibaadah standing between the Hajar Aswad and Maqaam (Ibraheem) and even though he performs salaah and fasts, he will still enter Jahannam if he bears enmity for the members of Muhammad's household."[^2]

Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ says, "Whoever does a good turn towards any member of Abdul Muttalib's progeny and is not recompensed in this world, it shall be my duty to repay him for it tomorrow (on the Day of Qiyaamah) when he meets me."[^3]
Hadhrat Umar (RA) is Overjoyed to be Related to Rasulullaah ﷺ

Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) narrates that on the occasion of Hadhrat Umar (RA)'s marriage to the daughter of Hadhrat Ali (RA), he heard Hadhrat Umar (RA) say to the people, "Will you not congratulate me? I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, 'On the Day of Qiyaamah, all relations and family ties will be severed besides my relations and family ties.'" (By marrying Hadhrat Ali (RA)'s daughter, Hadhrat Umar (RA) therefore established a tie of kinship with Rasulullaah ﷺ.)[^4]
